checkpoint_selection: Final@10; no epoch or checkpoint selection
test_rule: Evaluate only score/random three-seed pairs whose branch passes every dev gate; no test for failed branches; fixed clean gallery and Final@10
limits: Original human-caption dataset and controlled 20-percent reassignment are separate branches; synthetic mismatch is not a measured native error rate
CLIP cosine is a consistency proxy, not ground-truth correctness; fixed teacher biases may suppress valid detailed captions
All 28k images retained; four captions per image, equal updates/exposures/initialization/negative streams within each branch; five-caption historical reference has greater supervision and arithmetic
Same frozen CLIP scores used for selection and teacher; no independent-teacher or semantic-causality claim
Training uses no corruption flags or donor identities; diagnostic recovery flags are computed only after selection
Negative exclusions use the branch's pre-selection five-caption annotations; across clean/noisy branches these exclusions can differ
Dev/test historically exposed, pretraining overlap unknown; not blind testing, industrial Chinese product data, VLM SFT data synthesis or online deployment
Four primary endpoints share alpha .05/4; conditional fixed-checkpoint image-cluster intervals separate from three-seed sample SD; no correction for all historical experiments
Assistant-executed research does not establish user mastery or independent contribution; formal CV unchanged
